annotations.title: The property's own sale, carried to today

description:
The property's own last registered sale carried by the published
    repeat-sales index to its latest settled month: the price paid, the date,
    the index factor applied and the anchored value. Where a property has
    sold, this is the strongest single piece of evidence a valuation has.
    When no published series can carry the sale the factor and the anchored
    value are null and the anchor is diagnostic, never carried at 1.0.
    Returns an empty anchor when no registered sale is linked to the UPRN.
    UK only. Free. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: subject_transaction_anchor
